rationale: Builds on the current 9x512 reverse recurrent-tail best instead of changing shape or export structure. The edit adds a compile-stable schedule that starts the recurrent tail at reduced strength and ramps it to full strength before the late quant-aware endgame, aiming to reduce early optimization noise while preserving the proven final decoder-anchor recurrence and exact int8 roundtrip path. I also removed a few helper indirections to stay under the 1500-line cap.
title: Late Tail-Recur Gate Warmup On Reverse Recurrent Baseline
